Ui.Script:
-- Steps the bar by its valueStep. Deviation: one row on a faux list, where the reference -- bar's arrows step half its height. Soundless: the reference plays UChatScrollButton on -- an arrow click, never on the wheel, so the arrows' OnClick plays it. function BenillaScrollBar_Step(scrollBar, dir) local step = scrollBar:GetValueStep() if step <= 0 then step = 1 end scrollBar:SetValue(scrollBar:GetValue() + dir * step) end
-- Greys each arrow at its end of the range (reference: ScrollFrame_OnScrollRangeChanged). function BenillaScrollBar_UpdateArrows(scrollBar) local minV, maxV = scrollBar:GetMinMaxValues() local val = scrollBar:GetValue() local up = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "ScrollUpButton") local down = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "ScrollDownButton") if val <= minV then up:Disable() else up:Enable() end if val >= maxV then down:Disable() else down:Enable() end end
-- The faux bar's OnValueChanged: the top row is the value rounded to the nearest row, so -- thumb and rows agree, and `updateFunc` runs only when that row changes, which also ends -- the loop when a repaint re-seats the thumb. -- A ScrollFrame parent also gets the value through SetVerticalScroll, as the reference's -- `UIPanelScrollBarTemplate` routes it (UIPanelTemplates.xml l.156-158). function BenillaFauxScrollBar_OnValueChanged(scrollBar, value) local frame = scrollBar:GetParent() local step = scrollBar:GetValueStep() if step <= 0 then step = 1 end local newOffset = floor(value / step + 0.5) if newOffset ~= frame.offset then frame.offset = newOffset if frame.updateFunc then frame.updateFunc() end end BenillaScrollBar_UpdateArrows(scrollBar) if frame.SetVerticalScroll then frame:SetVerticalScroll(value) end end
-- Seats a trough on its bar with the reference's ReputationFrame hang, 8 left, 21 above and -- 20 below (ReputationFrame.xml l.573-599 against UIPanelTemplates.xml l.166-181), which -- puts each art socket on its arrow button. Lazy, because the bar is declared after its -- trough and does not exist at the trough's OnLoad. function BenillaScrollTrough_Seat(trough, scrollBar) if trough.seated then return end trough.seated = true trough:ClearAllPoints() trough:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", scrollBar, "TOPLEFT", -8, 21) trough:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", scrollBar, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 7, -20) end
-- Shows or hides a bar and its `<barname>Trough` together, seating the trough first; show -- and hide a bar only through here. The trough is opt-in because 1.12 draws trough art per -- window: `UIPanelScrollBarTemplate` carries only the arrows and the knob. function BenillaScrollBar_SetShown(scrollBar, shown) local trough = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "Trough") if trough then BenillaScrollTrough_Seat(trough, scrollBar) end if shown then scrollBar:Show() if trough then trough:Show() end else scrollBar:Hide() if trough then trough:Hide() end end end
-- The same for a stock `FauxScrollFrameTemplate` frame, whose bar is the reference's: seats -- `<frame>ScrollBarTrough` and mirrors the frame's shown state. Call it after -- `FauxScrollFrame_Update`, which shows or hides the frame. function BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scrollFrameName) local sf = getglobal(scrollFrameName) if not sf then return end local bar = getglobal(scrollFrameName .. "ScrollBar") if not bar then return end local trough = getglobal(bar:GetName() .. "Trough") if not trough then return end BenillaScrollTrough_Seat(trough, bar) if sf:IsShown() then trough:Show() else trough:Hide() end end
-- One row per wheel notch (+1 up) on a faux list, called from the owner window's -- OnMouseWheel since the spin bubbles up the parent chain. Benilla-named: the reference has -- no faux wheel function (its `ScrollFrameTemplate_OnMouseWheel` moves half the bar). function BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(frame, delta) local scrollBar = getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "ScrollBar") BenillaScrollBar_Step(scrollBar, -delta) end
-- ══════════════════════════ The real-scroll kit ══════════════════════════════════════════ -- Shaped on the reference `UIPanelScrollFrameTemplate` (UIPanelTemplates.xml l.166-211): -- the bar is a `Slider` child, `$parentBar`, so `bar:GetParent()` is the frame it pans. BENILLA_SCROLL_STEP = 20 -- px per arrow click or wheel notch BENILLA_SCROLL_PAD = 20 -- px of room below the child's last element
-- Pans the frame the bar rides. The loop back through OnVerticalScroll and SyncBar ends in -- one hop: SyncBar writes the value the bar already holds, which Slider:SetValue ignores. function BenillaScrollBar_OnValueChanged(bar, value) bar:GetParent():SetVerticalScroll(value) BenillaScrollBar_UpdateArrows(bar) end
-- Fits the bar to the frame's live range, [0, range] px, and hides it when the content fits -- (reference: ScrollFrame_OnScrollRangeChanged). Owners call it from OnScrollRangeChanged -- and OnVerticalScroll. function BenillaScroll_SyncBar(sf) local bar = getglobal(sf:GetName() .. "Bar") if not bar then return end local range = sf:GetVerticalScrollRange() bar:SetValueStep(BENILLA_SCROLL_STEP) bar:SetMinMaxValues(0, range) bar:SetValue(sf:GetVerticalScroll()) BenillaScrollBar_UpdateArrows(bar) BenillaScrollBar_SetShown(bar, range > 0) end
-- Pans by `delta` px, clamped here: SetVerticalScroll stores any value, as the reference's -- does; the reference's ScrollFrameTemplate_OnMouseWheel clamps through its bar's range. function BenillaScroll_Step(sf, delta) local target = sf:GetVerticalScroll() + delta local range = sf:GetVerticalScrollRange() if target > range then target = range end if target < 0 then target = 0 end sf:SetVerticalScroll(target) BenillaScroll_SyncBar(sf) end
-- The wheel's delta is +1 per notch up, and up scrolls toward the top. function BenillaScroll_OnMouseWheel(sf, delta) BenillaScroll_Step(sf, -delta * BENILLA_SCROLL_STEP) end
-- A widget's resolved bottom, or nil if hidden, a blank FontString, or not laid out yet. function BenillaScroll_WidgetBottom(w) if not w then return nil end if w.IsShown then if not w:IsShown() then return nil end elseif w.GetText then local t = w:GetText() if not t or t == "" then return nil end end return w:GetBottom() end
-- Sizes the scroll child to its lowest visible widget plus BENILLA_SCROLL_PAD and updates -- the frame's range. Rects resolve after Lua runs, so owners re-run it from OnUpdate until -- it returns false; it writes only on a real change, since SetHeight invalidates layout. function BenillaScroll_ResizeChild(scrollName, widgets) local sf = getglobal(scrollName) -- The frame's own child, not a derived name: the reference pairs `<X>ScrollFrame` with -- `<X>ScrollChildFrame`. local child = sf:GetScrollChild() if not child then return false end local top = child:GetTop() if not top then return false end local bottom = nil for i = 1, table.getn(widgets) do local b = BenillaScroll_WidgetBottom(getglobal(widgets[i])) if b and (not bottom or b < bottom) then bottom = b end end local height = 1 if bottom then height = (top - bottom) + BENILLA_SCROLL_PAD end if height < 1 then height = 1 end if math.abs(child:GetHeight() - height) < 1 then return false end child:SetHeight(height) sf:UpdateScrollChildRect() return true end
